_findings.defect: fallback mass on the converter's geom-less outer body tips the bowls over
_findings.detail: MJCF's unnamed outer <body> (sites only) becomes rigid body Geometry/Body with no collider and no MassAPI; PhysX falls back to a default mass. In the bowl that body sits 0.1 m off the bowl (MJCF <body name='object' pos='0 -0.1 0'>), welded to the colliding 'object' body.
_findings.evidence: run 1, 2026-10-19 (/home/user/libero_assets/spike/spike_libero_isaac_run1.json and .log): world welds disabled, no mass patch, 5 cm drop, 3 s at 60 Hz

unpatched.log: The rigid body at /Scene_0/objects/<inst>/Geometry/Body has a possibly invalid inertia tensor of {1.0, 1.0, 1.0} and a negative mass, small sphere approximated inertia was used (all 7 instances)
unpatched.note: fell_through is true under the brief's rule (body origin z < -0.05): the bowl lies tipped on the table while its colliderless body origin, 0.1 m away, hangs below the table top (run-1 overview render shows the tipped bowls). plate_1 / ramekin / cookies_1 (outer body at the object origin) stayed upright: rest z 0.0021 / -0.0009 / 0.0087 vs 0.0025 / -0.0007 / 0.0094 patched.

_findings.workaround: build_scene: MassAPI mass 1e-4 kg, diagonalInertia 1e-9, on each movable rigid body with no MassAPI and no own collider (massless_bodies_given_0.1g). Final run: both bowls upright, rest z -0.0016, speed 0.
_findings.why: every consumer of the USD hits it; the converter step should merge jointless nested bodies into one rigid body (MuJoCo semantics) or give the geom-less body a negligible mass

_findings.defect: every asset is welded to the world
_findings.detail: Geometry/Body/PhysicsFixedJoint has body0 = the asset's root Xform (no RigidBodyAPI, so PhysX anchors it to the world) and body1 = Geometry/Body (see world_joints per instance). LIBERO object MJCFs have no freejoint; robosuite adds one when placing.
_findings.evidence: static: USD inspection (world_joints in this file); dynamic: one-off run 2026-10-19 (/home/user/libero_assets/spike/spike_weld_oneoff.py and .log): build_scene, then the movables' world joints re-enabled, each placed via its root 5 cm above rest, 3 s at 60 Hz

unpatched.note: every movable hangs in the air at its release height

_findings.workaround: build_scene sets physics:jointEnabled = false on movables' world joints (disabled_world_joints); fixtures keep theirs (furniture)
_findings.why: Task 1's asset table already says object vs fixture; it should drop the root weld for objects and keep it for fixtures

_findings.defect: a fixture placed by moving its body snaps back to the world-joint anchor
_findings.detail: the fixture's world weld anchors to the reference root (body0 = root Xform, localPos0 = 0); writing Geometry/Body's translate leaves the joint disjointed and PhysX snaps the body back to the root
_findings.evidence: run 1: fixtures placed by writing Geometry/Body xformOp:translate in USD before play

unpatched.log: PhysicsUSD: CreateJoint - found a joint with disjointed body transforms, the simulation will most likely snap objects together (wooden_cabinet_1, flat_stove_1)
unpatched.side_effect: both fixtures at the origin interpenetrate; cabinet bottom_level stuck: reached_open -0.0241, reached_closed -0.0233 (limits -0.16 / 0.01)

_findings.workaround: place fixtures by writing the reference root (place_prim); final run: cabinet at (-0.2536, 0.2992), stove at (0.1522, 0.3), speed 0, every drawer reaches its limits
_findings.why: anchoring furniture to its root is correct; placement code (Task 3 Replicator) must write the root, not body_prim

_findings.defect: collision-only geoms (MJCF group 0) render as grey cubes over the textured meshes
_findings.detail: the converter keeps group-0 geoms as renderable Cube prims (displayColor 0.8, displayOpacity 0.3, which RTX does not honour without an opacity material); robosuite never renders group 0. Counts per instance: hidden_collision_geoms (bowl 40, ramekin 25, plate 10, cookies 1, cabinet 36, stove 20).
_findings.evidence: run 3 (/home/user/libero_assets/spike/spike_libero_isaac_run3.json, /home/user/libero_assets/spike/renders/run3_collision_visible/) vs the final renders, same cameras
_findings.workaround: build_scene sets purpose = guide on CollisionAPI Gprims whose mjc:group is not 1; PhysX ignores purpose
_findings.why: a render property of the asset; mapping MJCF group 0 to purpose guide at conversion fixes every scene

_findings.defect: camera near plane is 1 m (not an asset defect)
_findings.detail: UsdGeom.Camera's default clippingRange is (1, 1e6) scene units; with metersPerUnit = 1 everything closer than 1 m to the camera is clipped
_findings.evidence: run 1-2 close-ups (/home/user/libero_assets/spike/renders/run1/isaac_cabinet_open.png) and three diagnostic runs 2026-10-19 (scripts deleted; numbers from their output, quoted in the task-2 report)

unpatched.close-up eye 0.66 m from the cabinet: only geometry beyond 1 m rendered; the cabinet missing

_findings.why: camera setup, not the asset; any camera in a metre-unit stage that is closer than 1 m to its subject needs an explicit near plane
